title: Download Data Layout
applicability: Covers Appendix W's Download Data tables carried by Data Segment No. DL7 (Supplemental Terminal Data Segment); it does not assert standard Segment 100 financial request/response applicability.
source: specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt Appendix W-1; DL7 data framing from Section 12.48; Element 232 maximum from Section 13.2

businessRequirements.title: Appendix W Table ID and Table Length fields have n3 attributes and are framed as three-digit values followed by Table Data, within Element 232's 100-byte maximum.

Site Language uses fixed Table ID 001, fixed Table Length 003, and is described as an ISO 639-2 language code associated with the terminal; the conflicting an1 data attribute keeps data semantics review-gated.

Postal Code uses fixed Table ID 002, fixed Table Length 013, and is described as a 13-character international postal code associated with the transmitting device; the conflicting an1 data attribute keeps data semantics review-gated.
The Appendix W an1 Table Data attributes conflict with the fixed lengths and prose descriptions and require authoritative clarification.
The Site Language and Postal Code descriptions associate values with the terminal and transmitting device respectively; these external associations cannot be verified from Download Data alone.

testData.reason: Synthetic source-shaped Site Language and Postal Code records.
Table 001 may be supplied on its own; its framing parses, while the data semantics remain review-gated.
Table 002 may be supplied on its own; its framing parses, while the data semantics remain review-gated.
Table framing is parseable; whether this value satisfies the prose code description and an1 attribute needs clarification.
No source-backed character rule distinguishes this value from other three-character candidates.
A source-shaped 13-character postal candidate; no country-specific or character-set validity is assumed.
Table 002 data shorter than the stated 13-character length.
Punctuation is left review-gated because Appendix W does not resolve the an1 attribute and data character rules.
Table ID 003 is not defined by Appendix W.
Table ID must contain three numeric digits.
The declared Table Data is incomplete.
Element 232 is required in Segment DL7 and the Download Data value cannot contain zero records.
Order and uniqueness constraints are not stated; all individual records are valid.
Nine valid language records and one postal record total exactly 100 ASCII bytes.
Element 232 is limited to 100 bytes; this ASCII value is 104 bytes.
A literal one-alphanumeric-character reading of an1 conflicts with Table Lengths 003/013 and the descriptions.
